name: systemd-migration-harness
description: Verification and unattended execution for the systemd-dev-plugins migration set: a skill that validates rendered or installed units against the migration's expectations (dry-run and live), the cutover-verifier agent, and a Managed Agents harness (config-as-code for ant apply, a self-hosted worker split from a credential-free tool executor, and an operator CLI with an approval policy) that runs the migration agents on production hosts.

inventory_dir.title: Inventory directory
inventory_dir.description: Where rendered/expected.json is read from. Defaults to ./.swarm-migration inside the project, matching docker-swarm-to-systemd.
